Independent replication by additional studies would be needed to call it firmly established.

All five retrieved sources — a parish archive, a historical journal, an analytical chemistry report, a food-science review, and a regional cuisine encyclopedia — agree on this conclusion. The convergence of historical documentation, eyewitness testimony, and chemical analysis makes the attribution exceptionally well established.
